expectations.evidence: DataSource trait with read(&self, path) -> Result<DataFrame>. CsvSource, JsonSource, YamlSource as separate impls. source_for_format() factory function.

Transform trait with apply(self, df: DataFrame) -> Result<DataFrame>. Four separate structs: FilterTransform, SortTransform, RenameTransform, AddColumnTransform. Each owns its parameters. Adding a new transform = new struct + impl Transform.
Transforms collected into Vec<Box<dyn Transform>> and applied sequentially. Pipeline is data — can be serialized, logged, or reordered.

DataFrame (columns + rows as HashMap<String, String>) is the internal representation. DataSource reads into DataFrame, transforms operate on DataFrame, DataSink writes from DataFrame. Complete decoupling.
